title: FATCA – Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act

versions.text: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA). Requires foreign financial institutions to report accounts held by U.S. taxpayers. Withholding of 30% on certain payments to non-participating FFIs. Individual reporting: Form 8938 (Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets). Intergovernmental Agreements (IGAs) with partner jurisdictions.
